body:
Founder real-time: need to start the kubernetes migration, look up the plan in fatbaby, logstreaming data going to GCS, the data is already there. Found the existing plan (docs/architecture-distributed-event-intelligence.md Phase 5). Confirmed GCS data-durability is real and live (emily backup run --target fatbaby). Found a real architectural gap: Phase 2 dual-sink fanout exists as scaffolding only, wired into no running process -- every pipeline process still depends on local ./var/ disk state, mattering for k8s Pod statelessness. Wrote docs/northstar/KUBERNETES_MIGRATION.md (phased plan, PVC-first by default, flagged the PVC-vs-Phase-2 branch for the founder), docker/dashboard.Dockerfile (first representative service, unverified -- no docker in session), k8s/dashboard.yaml (Deployment+PVC+Service, YAML-validated, not cluster-applied -- no gcloud auth in session). Registered as KUBERNETES-MIGRATION-NORTH. Commit 3617c40.

⚓ ☃
title: Kubernetes migration — real plan found, first Dockerfile + manifest
